# PantryPal

Snap a photo of your fridge, get 3 recipes.

## How it works

1. Open PantryPal and tap the camera button.
2. Take one photo of your open fridge.
3. PantryPal detects the ingredients and suggests three recipes you can cook right now.

## Features

- Ingredient detection from a single photo
- Three recipes ranked by how many of your ingredients they use
- Shopping list for the few things you are missing

![Home screen](docs/home.png)

## Run it

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn backend.main:app
```
